card.name: Space before age or weight cutoff
card.fires_on: The space right after a limit phrase such as "less than", "below", "under", "over" or "up to", just before a number for age or weight. It appears in pediatric dosing text.

modes.label: Age cutoff
modes.description: Space after "less than", "below" or "under" before a child's age in years.

modes.label: Weight cutoff
modes.description: Space after "less than" or "over" before a body weight in kg.
modes.example: • Pediatric patients weighing less than<< >>40 kg: 3 mg/kg

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for a number to come next, though the promoted tokens are unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the gap after "less than" or "under" just before an age or weight number in child dosing.
